verdict.line: You lose if you trade into Obliterate before level 3 or overextend for CS pre-6; you win if you survive to Dusk and Dawn and let Hallowed Mist wall off his poke.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser outranges you the whole early lane — Obliterate hits at 675 and Death's Grasp pulls at 700, while your Snip Snip! only reaches 450 and Skip 'n Slash only 400 — so before level 3 you have nothing to answer his poke with. That range and cooldown edge is exactly why OP.GG lists him with lane and solo-kill advantage, but the 54.7% Gwen win rate over 547 games shows the matchup flips once Hallowed Mist can block his hits from outside and your build starts landing.

theirWindow.what: You have no Hallowed Mist yet and he outranges every poke option you own. Sit off minion aggro range, take the potion sustain from Doran's Ring, and do not contest trades — just soak the Obliterate hits you can't avoid.

yourWindow.when: Right after he uses Obliterate (8/7/6/5/4s cooldown)
yourWindow.what: That's your dash window. Land Skip 'n Slash to close the gap while his only real poke tool is down, get your empowered autos off, and disengage before it comes back up.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 88.3% pick rate and 55.5% win rate over 620 games — the extra potion sustain matters because you're absorbing Obliterate poke with no mist for the first two levels.

boots.why: 60.6% win rate over 289 games. Mordekaiser's kit here has no hard CC to punish you for skipping Mercury's Treads, so take the magic penetration to shorten trades once you're in Skip 'n Slash range.

core.why: First item in the 57.1%-winrate, 98-game line — this is the spike that lets you start winning extended trades instead of just surviving them.
Second item in the same line; burst damage against a target you've already softened with A Thousand Cuts stacks.
Closes out the highest-sample core path (98 games, 57.1% win rate) once you're ahead in scaling.

runes.keystoneWhy: This lane comes down to who wins the extended trade once mist is up — Conqueror's ramping damage and heal is what lets you out-grind his Indestructible shield sustain instead of losing the war of attrition.

summoners.why: 54.8% win rate at 69.4% pick — the highest-sample combo. Ignite matters specifically because Mordekaiser can consume Indestructible's shield to heal through a close trade; the burn denies that reset when you finally get him low.

playing.title: Never trade before level 3
playing.detail: You have no Hallowed Mist until your third point, and Obliterate outranges everything you own at 450/400. Play for CS only, not damage.

playing.title: Bait Obliterate, then dash in
playing.detail: His Q is 8/7/6/5/4s on cooldown depending on rank. The moment it's used on you or a minion, that's your window to land Skip 'n Slash and get your on-hit window off safely.

playing.title: Wall his Death's Grasp with mist
playing.detail: Enemies outside Hallowed Mist can't target you, so when he goes for the pull he either wastes it on nothing or has to walk into the mist first — either way you see the all-in coming.

playing.title: Track his Darkness Rise stacks
playing.detail: His passive triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells and grants him a damage aura plus move speed. If he's one hit from proc, disengage rather than eat the empowered follow-up.

playing.title: Respect the solo-kill data pre-6
playing.detail: OP.GG flags him with the solo-kill edge in this window. Don't extend for a last-hit at low HP — his Q-to-auto burst closes distance faster than you can punish.

playing.title: Use Snip Snip! only when he's out of Q range
playing.detail: Your Q's 450 range is still shorter than his 675 Obliterate, so poking through minions only works when he's disengaged or on cooldown, not as a standing trade tool.

playing.title: Play for the level 9+ item spike
playing.detail: Once Dusk and Dawn is up, start initiating trades yourself — this is the point where the measured 54.7% head-to-head win rate actually starts to show up on the scoreboard.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner picks, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the range comparisons, cooldown timing, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own read of the matchup, not measured data.
